questions.concept: Items customers are least comfortable buying online
questions.question: Customers are generally LEAST comfortable buying which of the following items online?
questions.explanation: Customers are most comfortable buying books, software, PCs and digital items online, and less comfortable with large physical items like automobiles and furniture.

questions.concept: Insertion time complexity in linked list
questions.question: As per the linked list time complexity table, what is the average and worst case time complexity of insertion in a linked list?
questions.explanation: Insertion and deletion in a linked list are O(1) in both average and worst cases, while search is O(n).

questions.question: Which was the first AI programming language?
questions.explanation: LISP, created by John McCarthy, was the first AI programming language. Prolog came later; Python is preferred today.

questions.concept: Meaning of B in the TM 7-tuple
questions.question: In the formal 7-tuple definition of a Turing machine, what does B denote?
questions.explanation: In the 7-tuple, B is the blank symbol, q0 the initial state, F the set of final states and delta the transition function.

questions.question: Compared with twisted pair cable, coaxial cable:

options.A: Has more bandwidth and is better shielded
options.B: Carries data as light through a glass core
options.C: Consists of two insulated copper wires twisted together
options.D: Is cheaper and more common in telephone lines

questions.explanation: Coaxial cable has more bandwidth than twisted pair and is better shielded; the other options describe twisted pair or fiber.

questions.concept: IT Act notification and amendment years
questions.question: India's Information Technology (IT) Act was notified in ____ and amended in ____.
questions.explanation: The IT Act was notified in 2000 and amended in 2008.

questions.concept: C++ invention year and first release year
questions.question: C++ was invented in ____ and its first version was released in ____.
questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup began C++ in 1979 and the first version was released in 1983. 1972 relates to C and 1995 to Java.

questions.question: Which technique is used for error correction rather than only error detection?
questions.explanation: Hamming codes, invented by Richard Hamming, can correct errors; parity, checksum and CRC are detection techniques.

questions.question: A company must ensure that data intercepted on its network cannot be understood by outsiders. Which mechanism directly provides this confidentiality?
questions.explanation: Confidentiality is achieved using encryption, not networking or compression; authorization only controls access rights, not readability of intercepted data.

questions.concept: Beta testing performed by group of customers
questions.question: Testing in which a version of the software is given to a group of customers to use in their own real environment before market release is:
questions.explanation: Beta testing is carried out by a group of customers at the client end in a real environment before release; alpha testing happens at the developer's end.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the four main parts of computer organization?
questions.explanation: The four main parts are CPU, memory, input devices and output devices. A compiler is software.

questions.question: In MySQL, what is the permitted range of the length n in the data type VARCHAR(n)?
questions.explanation: VARCHAR(n) is a variable-length type with n from 0 to 65535; the 0 to 255 range belongs to CHAR(n).

questions.concept: SRTF is the preemptive form of SJF
questions.question: Which CPU scheduling algorithm is the preemptive version of Shortest Job First?
questions.explanation: SRTF preempts the running job when a new job with a shorter remaining time arrives; SJF itself is non-preemptive.

questions.question: Connecting a mobile phone to a laptop with a USB cable to transfer photos forms which type of network?
questions.explanation: A PAN connects a few personal devices within about 10 m and may be wired (USB) or wireless.

questions.question: The process of converting a byte stream back into a Python object is called:
questions.explanation: Pickling (serialization) turns an object into a byte stream, and unpickling (deserialization) turns the byte stream back into an object.

questions.concept: Elements not allowed in the head section
questions.question: Which of the following does NOT belong in the head section of an HTML document?
questions.explanation: The head holds title, meta and script declarations; tables are visible content and belong in the body.

questions.question: SQL Server is owned and developed by which company?
questions.explanation: SQL Server is a Microsoft product; Oracle was the first to commercially distribute SQL.

questions.question: L1 and L2 are both regular languages. Using the closure properties of regular languages, L1 intersection L2 is:
questions.explanation: Intersection is listed among the operations under which regular languages are closed, so the result stays regular.

questions.concept: Reason value discovery matters in big data
questions.question: Why is discovering 'Value' considered especially important when dealing with Big Data?

options.A: Because big data is always fully structured
options.B: Because processing big data requires investment of resources
options.C: Because traditional DBMS tools easily process it
options.D: Because big data is generated at a slow, steady rate

questions.explanation: Big data may contain hidden patterns of business value, and value discovery matters because processing it requires investing resources. The other statements contradict the nature of big data.

questions.concept: Platform independence is not an OOP concept
questions.question: Which of the following does NOT come under the concepts of OOP?
questions.explanation: Data hiding, message passing and data binding are OOP concepts. Platform independence is a property of a language's execution model (such as Java's JVM), not an OOP concept.

questions.concept: Gate count in full adder from half adders
questions.question: A full adder is built from 2 half adders and 1 OR gate, where each half adder uses one XOR gate and one AND gate. How many XOR and AND gates does the full adder contain in total?
questions.explanation: Each of the two half adders contributes one XOR and one AND, giving 2 XOR and 2 AND gates, plus the single OR gate for the carry.

questions.concept: Valid state sequence for a process that performs I/O
questions.question: A new process is created, runs, issues one I/O request, resumes after the I/O and then finishes. Which sequence of states is valid?

options.A: New, Running, Wait, Ready, Running, Terminated
options.B: New, Ready, Running, Wait, Ready, Running, Terminated
options.C: New, Ready, Running, Wait, Running, Terminated
options.D: New, Ready, Running, Ready, Wait, Running, Terminated

questions.explanation: A process is admitted to Ready, dispatched to Running, moves to Wait on I/O, returns to Ready on completion (never directly to Running), is dispatched again and then exits.

questions.question: Given str1 = 'Hello World!', what does str1[::-1][:5] return?
questions.explanation: str1[::-1] gives '!dlroW olleH', and taking its first five characters gives '!dlro'.

questions.question: According to the bubble sort rule, how many passes are made to sort a list of 10 elements?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort makes n-1 passes for n elements, so 10 elements need 9 passes.

questions.question: Which type of scheduling scheme is considered most suitable for a real-time operating system?
questions.explanation: A real-time OS must respond immediately to urgent tasks, so a running process must be interruptible; hence a preemptive scheme is most suitable.
